description: Statement of Work generator — Draft a complete Statement of Work from a project description: objective, scope, out-of-scope, deliverables with measurable acceptance criteria, milestones with payment percentages (and amounts from your budget), assumptions, client/vendor responsibilities, change control and risks, plus Markdown. Offline checks: payments sum to 100%, timeline overrun, deliverables missing acceptance criteria, undefined deliverables, vague phrases (etc, as needed, TBD) and a 0-100 quality score. Optional: budget, weeks, client, vendor. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

project.description: e.g. Build a Shopify store with 20 products, Stripe payments and basic SEO for a candle brand
